description: A middle-aged man with greying hair and a short beard, in a dark gown with a heavy fur collar, stands at a wooden counter and reads a large open book, a hand on each page. The setting is a dim, candlelit apothecary: shelves of ceramic jars and glass flasks, bundles of dried herbs hanging from the beams, a brass mortar and pestle, a balance scale, small vials and scattered herbs on the counter. The dress, jars and scale fit the 16th century. Some jars carry small pale label patches with a few illegible brown marks, and the book pages are soft horizontal brushstrokes. There is no border, frame or canvas edge, and nothing gory.
